cohort.primary: original selected opening rank 1-2; other ranks only descriptive and phase matched controls
cohort.direction_and_pool: original previous-day pool, fixed R8 sign and separate group/direction ranks, no replacement or reversal
base_environment: complete current-session 15m MA10/MA20 directional order, MA20 slope3 and close beyond MA20
1m close beyond MA20 and beyond the immediately preceding close
hard_data_checks: original previous-day contract pool and trading permission
every scheduled minute from day opening through observation present
1m/5m/15m causal indicator readiness; positive previous 1m ATR
no locked test or next-day label
cohort.clock: every completed minute after the first current-session 15m bar, strictly before the original entry cutoff; original causal indicator cache
cohort.segment: same contract/day/direction/session; base-qualified minute clocks separated by at most 30 trading minutes share a causal segment; first base clock opens it; while same session and at most 30 trading minutes since the latest base clock it remains eligible for strict readiness; missing hard data/cutoff/end closes it; never delete a never-strict segment
cohort.strict_clock: first minute in the causally live segment at which ALL original market flags pass, including minutes without the base continuation candle; exclude only candidate/state/entry_time; do not wait again until execution passes
cohort.scope_limit: strict market readiness is not a portfolio trigger; join prior control diagnostics, triggers and real fills without rerunning them
cohort.missing_strict: never_strict retained as its own outcome, not a zero-return substitute
cohort.outside_segment: original strict clocks that precede the first base environment or occur after expiry without new base recovery are saved and counted as outside-cohort cases, not forced into a segment

execution.clock: at first strict clock and exactly its next scheduled minute open, skipping calendar breaks but not missing or nonfillable bars; no future endpoint data used to classify eligibility
execution.unchanged: original cost/1m ATR <=0.5, signal and next-open cost, original signal price cap, stop floors, initial capital and all integer risk/margin/minimum/daily caps
execution.account: empty-portfolio capacity is an upper bound on available lots and minimum capital a lower bound; actual published state/trigger/fill joined separately
execution.rejects: record every failure; future exit fee availability must not determine entry eligibility; no retry after first strict refusal

labels.own_horizon: base next-open to base+hth close; strict next-open to strict+hth close, 5/15/30 trading minutes separately; different market intervals must remain explicit
labels.common_endpoint: each base endpoint is fixed BEFORE strict eligibility; strict entry to that same close only if it precedes the endpoint; if wait >= h report late_strict_no_remaining_minutes and keep the segment
labels.common_scaling: paired changes use the base signal ATR, base next raw open for bps and the unchanged metadata tick for ticks, so ATR/entry denominator changes cannot manufacture a waiting improvement
metrics: signed gross price, net price, ATR, bps and price ticks
fixed endpoint extra one adverse tick each side
labels.future_data: labels only; no stops, breakeven, trail, portfolio competition or force-close strategy return; censor absent scheduled minutes/day end/unknown execution; report endpoints after original force close

matching.representative: both members must be FIRST occurrences of the SAME decision stage, not a control mid-segment clock
matching.age: age is trading minutes since first base clock, available from the past; absolute age difference <=5, fixed before labels
matching.distance: absolute log volume ratio + absolute log relative ATR ratio; deterministic contract tie break; no reuse at one clock/comparison/stage
matching.limitations: same-product exact match impossible within a date; phase control reduces coverage, not a causal estimate; no parameter search
matching.prior_matching_check: audit segment age and representative status in all original frozen pairs; report original pairs with both base representatives as a fixed sensitivity without replacing the prior study

execution_supplement.targets: September missing CZCE contract/date members of prior rank 1-2 vs rank 6+ matched pairs, ordered by date and contract, maximum 16; only prior missing qualifications, never future returns
execution_supplement.documents: reuse locally archived official exact-previous-day CZCE settlement tables with original receipts and hashes; no bulk minute-data acquisition
execution_supplement.specification: keep original contract metadata tick/units, same supplier historical-continuity assumption already declared for reviewed CZCE cases; explicitly NOT dated official historical specification verification
execution_supplement.coverage: fee/margin/daily limit must be exactly parsed for the exact contract/date; otherwise unknown; DCE and GFEX non-LC remain unknown without sufficient dated documents
execution_supplement.analysis: original qualification remains primary; supplementary resolver and same locked pairs reported separately, no rewriting old configs or replacing trades

aggregation.primary: average within contract/day/direction, then within trading day, then equally over observed days; no money sum presented as portfolio profit
aggregation.paired: average differences within contract/day/direction, then date, then equal dates; both endpoints complete; gross same economic subset shown beside net
aggregation.uncertainty: 95% trading-day cluster bootstrap of daily means, 2000 resamples, fixed seed 20261009; descriptive only, does not repair repeated-development selection bias
required_views: same-segment base among eventual strict vs all-base to separate selection from timing
same endpoint and own horizon separately
each month, rank 1-2 separately, product and non-LC/financial/commodity
execution and raw/economic coverage; causes of censoring; absolute price and ATR alongside bps/ticks
aggregation.stopping: finish this limited study after the three scans; do not tune any threshold or exit to repair it. If first-strict executable price labels do not show positive cost room repeating across windows, dates and products, record no repeatable edge observed and stop patching this entry hypothesis; any positive subset needs pre-identifiable frozen rules and fresh independent data, never promotion from these 52 days

provenance.implementation_location: isolated docs script, reusing the 57 existing frozen research Python files
